name: Matsushima Michiru
source:
A second-year student of Mihama Academy, Michiru is a fake tsundere with bleached blond twin tails. She has a deep interest in the tsundere character and tries to act like one. Her silly and energetic personality makes her the moodmaker of the class. However, Michiru's grades are bad. She always carries around a shark-shaped pouch which contains lemonade sweets. Despite having difficulty with sour foods, she still tries to drink 100% pure-Vitamin C drinks in order to “improve her intelligence”, as Michiru has herself stated. She has encountered a great deal of bad luck since her birth but has always managed to get through these ordeals in one way or another.

Her representative fruit is lemon.

[From [url=http://vnsharing.net/forum/showthread.php?t=302644/]Shiori-chan's review[/url]]
